def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if 3 in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h))]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    # Interior is a canvas: color it light, preserving the frame and marker.
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            out[r][c] = 4
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(r0 + 1, r1)
               for c in range(c0 + 1, c1) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    if not markers:
        return out
    mr, mc = markers[0]
    # Draw a square outline around the interior marker, expanding outwards.
    radius = min(mr - r0 - 1, r1 - mr - 1, mc - c0 - 1, c1 - mc - 1)
    if radius > 0:
        for c in range(mc - radius, mc + radius + 1):
            out[mr - radius][c] = 2
            out[mr + radius][c] = 2
        for r in range(mr - radius, mr + radius + 1):
            out[r][mc - radius] = 2
            out[r][mc + radius] = 2
    out[mr][mc] = 3
    return out
